about: Prompt templates and slot fills for video-fan-cam, read by scripts/fancam.mjs. The two templates are the assessment's adapted prompts A1 (still) and A2 (motion) from WF38-a1, reshaped by the WF38 enrichments; the format and reaction fills and the reframe variant are SL8's construction. None of this wording has been run on any model on SL8. An empty {aspect_line} drops out for gpt-image-2 (its size is set by image_size). A reaction row with `tight` replaces its fields for the head-and-shoulders formats (close-up cutaway, replay) so the beat stays in frame. A clip under 4 s keeps the last two moves of a three-move beat. The default pair (celebrating, close-up cutaway) is the first thing VID-L420 tests.
slots: {sport} {venue} {context} {crowd_mood} {crop} {framing} {expression} {still_note} come from the brief and the format and reaction rows for the still; {may_move} {beat} {range} {camera} {camera_end} {motion_note} for the clip. An empty optional slot drops out with its lead-in.
copy_check: Rows with `from` restate a source whose wording may not be copied (everygen, copy false in workflow-sources.json); workflow-check.mjs copy tests their `prompt` against it. Rows without `from` cite only copyable sources (fal agent skills, used with attribution; Kling AI skill, MIT) or the assessment's own A1/A2, listed in `cites`; `copied` names any line kept word for word.

rows.prompt: Edit Image 1 into one frame of a live sports broadcast: a spectator cutaway of this person in the crowd. Keep the facial features exactly the same as Image 1, and keep the hair, skin marks and build recognizable. Setting: {sport} at {venue}{context}, crowd mood {crowd_mood}. Framing: {framing}. Expression and pose: {expression}. Look: candid live TV camera, telephoto compression, stadium lighting, not a posed studio portrait. Generic broadcast styling only: no real network logos, no real team marks, no scoreboard text, no captions, no readable text anywhere in the frame.{still_note}{aspect_line}
copied: fal/charactersheet-a2ae87@edit-mode identity clause (nano-banana-pro/edit): keep the facial features exactly the same as Image 1

rows.prompt: Animate this exact frame; do not redraw it. Fixed: the person's face, hair, build and clothing, their place in the crowd, the venue and the lighting. May move: {may_move}; the crowd behind reacts naturally. Action: {beat}, with the last second left for the settled state. Range: {range}. Camera: {camera}, ending {camera_end}. The camera holds mostly steady with only mild handheld inertia, never shaking, jolting or hunting for focus. The person stays recognizable in every frame. No new text or logos appear.{motion_note}
a tight telephoto cutaway on the person, head and shoulders, sharp against a soft crowd
rows.camera: a locked-off telephoto shot with slight drift

rows.prompt: a wider shot of the stands, the person in the front rows on one third of the frame with neighbours around them
rows.camera: a slow sideways pan along the row
rows.camera_end: with the person centred in the frame

rows.prompt: a medium shot of the person reacting, a stadium screen behind them too soft and distant to read
rows.camera: a held medium shot with slight drift

rows.prompt: a medium close shot as if from a broadcast replay camera
rows.camera: a smooth, slightly slowed replay move pushing in gently
rows.camera_end: a little closer on the face

rows.prompt: mouth open, eyes wide, hands rising toward the head
rows.beat: watching the play, then a gasp as both hands go to the head, then holding still and staring
rows.range: small (head and hands only, seated or standing as in the first frame)

rows.prompt: mid-cheer, arms up, a wide smile
rows.beat: watching, then jumping up to cheer with arms raised, then settling with a smile and a wave
rows.may_move: face, arms and upper body, rising to stand
rows.range: medium (rising from the seat at most, in the same place in the row)

tight.prompt: mid-cheer, a wide smile, one fist raised to the shoulder
tight.beat: watching, then breaking into a cheer with a fist raised to the shoulder, then settling with a smile and a wave
tight.may_move: face, head, shoulders and one hand
tight.range: small to medium (head and shoulders stay in frame; the body stays in its seat)

rows.prompt: hands clasped at the chin, lips pressed together
rows.beat: watching tensely, then leaning forward as the hands tighten, then holding the breath with eyes fixed on the play
rows.may_move: face, hands and a small lean forward
rows.range: small (the body stays in its seat)

rows.prompt: mid-chant, mouth open, one fist raised
rows.beat: chanting with the crowd, then pumping the fist in time, then holding the fist up while still chanting
rows.may_move: mouth, the raised arm and the shoulders
rows.range: small to medium (one arm moves, the body stays in place)

rows.prompt: laughing, eyes creased, head tilted back a little
rows.beat: smiling, then bursting out laughing and glancing at a neighbour, then settling with a grin

rows.prompt: eyes glistening, one hand over the mouth
rows.beat: watching, then pressing a hand to the mouth as the eyes well up, then holding there, moved

rows.prompt: a wider crowd shot taken from farther back and a little higher, the person smaller in the frame and turned partly away from the camera, still identifiable
